- `GET /v2/playlists/TvPI9JOs` — Retrieve a specific playlist's details.

### Data Write (12)
- `POST /{id}` — Submit data associated with a specific ID.
- `POST /{id}/auction` — Submit auction data for a specific ID.
- `POST /api/v/{vId}` — Submit data to a versioned API endpoint.
- `POST /api/v1/prebid` — Submit a prebid request.
- `POST /bid/bidder/cafemedia` — Submit a bid to the CafeMedia bidder.
- `POST /dynasty-rankings/histories` — Submit historical dynasty rankings data.
- `POST /hb/bid-request` — Submit a header bidding request.
- `POST /openrtb_2_5/pbjs/auction/request` — Submit an auction request (OpenRTB 2.5, Prebid.js).
- `POST /openrtb/pbjs` — Submit a bid request using Prebid.js.
- `POST /openrtbb/prebidjs` — Submit a bid request using Prebid.js (OpenRTB).
- `POST /universal/v1` — Submit data to the universal endpoint.
- `POST /ut/v3/prebid` — Submit a prebid request (UT v3).

### Config (3)
